author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when artificial intelligence meets the psychology of extremism? Drawing on years of academic research and undercover work inside extremist movements, Julia Ebner reveals how emerging technologies are transforming and accelerating radicalisation, and how AI could help build a more resilient and less polarised society. 

Dr Julia Ebner is an international expert on online radicalisation, violent extremism and threats to democracy. She leads the Violent Extremism Lab at the University of Oxford and is Co-Executive Director at the Institute for Strategic Dialogue. She is passionate about researching and countering digital threats to democracy and has worked with various governments, intelligence agencies, as well as the UN, Europol and NATO. Her undercover investigations inside extremist movements combined with her academic work have provided her with a deeper understanding of where human vulnerabilities intersect with technological change. title: Extremists are using AI to radicalize us—can we fight back? | Julia Ebner | TEDxBerlin

author: TEDx Talks
description:
AI can process information, generate ideas and solve increasingly complex problems. But there are things you cannot download, including trust, courage and the human connection that holds a team together when the stakes are high. Drawing on his experience as an extreme mountaineer, mountain guide and leadership expert, Rainer Petek explores what makes a team truly resilient and why the most important superpower may be the people we can rely on when the stakes are high.

TEDxGöttingen 2026 was initiated, organized and moderated by Patrick Bartl. The event brought together ten speakers from science, business and society to explore the theme “Unleashing Superpowers – Ideas that Transform Systems.”

 Rainer Petek, Certified Speaking Professional and Global Speaking Fellows, is the author of ten books, trusted advisor, global keynote speaker and former extreme mountaineer. As a 19-year-old, he climbed the north face of the Grandes Jorasses, one of the most difficult walls in the Alps. As a
title: What AI Can’t Replace: The Rope Team You Can’t Download | Rainer Petek | TEDxGöttingen

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Los grandes problemas no comienzan siendo grandes. Antes, dejan señales. Un conflicto antes de estallar. Una persona antes de decir "no puedo más". Uno
equipo antes de romperse. Incluso nosotros mismos antes de llegar al límite. El problema es que a menudo reconocemos muy bien las señales cuando ya conocemos el final de la historia. En esta ponencia, Manel Fernández Jaria propone aprender a mirar
de otro modo y convertirnos en “leederas de señales”: personas capaces buscarlas, interpretarlas y tener el coraje de actuar. Porque ésta es, sobre todo, una charla sobre la esperanza: la esperanza de que podemos cambiar las cosas si actuamos a tiempo. Manel Fernández Jaria és especialista en lideratge i cohesió d’equips.
Acompanya persones i organitzacions en processos de canvi, desenvolupament del lideratge i millora de les relacions professionals.
Compagina la seva activitat professional amb la docència i l’escriptura, i
participa habitualment en mitjans de comunicació. La seva trajectòria
title: ¿Y si todavía estamos a tiempo? | Manel Fernández Jaria | TEDxReus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Medimos reproducciones, seguidores, entradas vendidas y resultados de una canción. Pero ¿cuánto sabemos del impacto de ese proceso en la persona que la creó?

En esta charla TEDx reflexiono sobre las responsabilidades de la industria musical, las audiencias y los propios artistas. Sobre el acompañamiento emocional, la formación, la planificación económica y la importancia de comprender para qué hacemos lo que hacemos.

¿Qué parte nos toca a cada uno para sostener a quienes nos conmueven? Analista en marketing musical, cantante y estratega. Impulsa a artistas emergentes mediante mentorías y visibilidad. Es fundadora de proyectos colaborativos que promueven el desarrollo profesional dentro de la industria musical independiente. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: ¿Quién cuida a los artistas? | Eloísa Méndez | TEDxColonia Del Sacramento

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Michele Russo is a Professor at SDA Bocconi and an Associate Data Scientist at Analytics Arts, bringing together academic depth and hands on industry expertise. In his talk, Michele reveals how AI can now build synthetic personas that think, choose and even misjudge just like real people. Through his own experiments, he shows these fabricated "consumers" developing real personalities, rational pricing instincts and human like irrational quirks, leaving us with a sharper question than how smart AI has become: how much of ourselves are we willing to hand over to it?
 "Prof. Michele Russo teaches Business Data Analytics at SDA Bocconi School of Management, with research spanning artificial intelligence, machine learning, consumer behaviour, and business decision-making. His work bridges academic research with practical business applications.
By showing how data can reveal patterns that often go unnoticed, he offers a unique way of understanding decisions and human behaviour. His insights
title: Building People Who Don't Exist | Michele Russo | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description: Sevdiğimiz birini kaybetme korkusu, kendi hayatımızı yeniden kurmanın başlangıcı olabilir mi? Neşe Merdinler bu konuşmada, babasının Alzheimer teşhisiyle başlayan ve hayatını kökten değiştiren yolculuğunu anlatıyor. Babasının giderek değişen dünyasına eşlik ederken yaşadığı korku, yoğun stres ve panik ataklarla yüzleşmesini; ardından zihnin değişebilme kapasitesini keşfederek kontrol etme ihtiyacından kabullenmeye uzanan dönüşümünü paylaşıyor. Nöroplastisite üzerine yaptığı araştırmalardan ve kişisel deneyimlerinden hareketle, düşünce kalıplarımızı sorgulamanın ve kendimizi yeniden inşa etmenin mümkün olduğunu hatırlatıyor. Merdinler, kaybın yalnızca bir son olmadığını; sevdiklerimizin bizde bıraktığı değerleri yaşatarak yeni bir anlam ve yön bulabileceğimizi gösteriyor. (TEDxAdana Women 2026'da kaydedilmiştir.) Neşe Merdinler, kognitif nörobilim ve nöropsikoloji alanlarında eğitim almış bir yönetim danışmanı, eğitmen, konuşmacı ve yazardır. Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi Matematik Mühend
title: Eşikteki Işık | Neşe Merdinler | TEDxAdana Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Gayatri Datar is an actress who has spent close to a decade working predominantly in the Marathi entertainment industry. In her talk, Gayatri takes us through the messier side of chasing a dream, arriving in Mumbai with next to nothing, learning the hard way what things actually cost and slowly realizing that ambition without boundaries can quietly become its own trap. She opens up about the years she spent measuring her worth by how much she worked and how choosing to be vulnerable, on camera and off, is ultimately what helped her find herself again.  "Gayatri Datar is a Marathi actress best known for her role as Isha Nimkar in Tula Pahate Re. Since then, she has worked across television and films, earning recognition for her natural performances and versatility.
As someone who brings diverse characters to life, she understands the many perspectives that shape stories and emotions. Her experiences in the entertainment industry would offer audiences a thoughtful look at identity, expr
title: Fame Isn't the Finish Line  | Gayatri Datar | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Mukesh Jain is the Executive Vice President and CTO of Capgemini. In his talk, Mukesh draws on three decades of building products used by billions to show that innovation and mistakes are inseparable. He shares real stories from Microsoft, Hotmail and Jio on how small errors quietly sank even the biggest products and reveals a powerful framework for building failure proof systems, so innovation never gets killed by fear of getting it wrong. Mukesh Jain is the Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer at Capgemini, leading global initiatives in AI, data, and digital transformation. With over three decades of experience, he has also held leadership roles at Microsoft, Reliance Jio, NICE, and VFS Global.
His work explores how technology can reshape businesses and everyday life. His perspective on innovation, leadership, and responsible AI would encourage audiences to rethink the role of technology and make for a thought-provoking conversation. This talk was given at a TEDx ev
title: The Art of Making Mistakes | Mukesh Jain | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Akhilesh Gupta is Director of AI Solutions at Altir and an alumnus of SDA Bocconi Asia Center. In his talk, Akhilesh reflects on how changing the lens through which he measured success enabled some of the biggest pivots in his career. Moving across dramatically different industries, he explores how people, experiences and the metrics we choose can reshape our perspective, challenge familiar definitions of progress and open the door to reinvention. His story reminds us that sometimes meaningful change begins not by changing where we are, but by changing what we choose to see and measure. "Akhilesh Gupta is the CEO of Altir, where he helps organizations accelerate digital transformation through AI, enterprise technology, and innovation. An alumnus of SDA Bocconi Asia Center, he combines entrepreneurial thinking with deep expertise in emerging technologies and business strategy.
His journey reflects how technology is most impactful when it solves real human problems. With experience span
title: Redefining the Measure of Success  | Akhilesh Gupta | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
L. C. Singh is the Founder and Executive Chairman of Nihilent. In this talk, L. C. Singh revisits a night in 1979 when he landed in Karachi without a visa, fleeing revolution-torn Tehran, and found an immigration officer's hostility dissolve the moment they discovered a shared love of ghazals. From that memory and a mid-air turbulence scare years later, he unpacks how emotion is the lens through which we construct reality and why learning to recognise that lens, rather than trust it blindly, may be the most important skill leadership and technology can offer us. "L. C. Singh is the Founder and Executive Chairman of Nihilent, and an alumnus of both IIT BHU and Harvard Business School. A technologist, filmmaker, photographer, and author, his work today explores the intersection of leadership, Emotion AI, and human-centred technology. He is the author of Things We Don't See and The Collapse of Illusions, both of which challenge conventional ways of thinking.
His journey is rooted in ques
title: The Lens You Didn't Know You Were Wearing | LC Singh | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description: Shreya Karmakar is a Mumbai-based singer-songwriter, performer and independent artist. In her talk, Shreya challenges us to see struggle through a different lens. From taking a leap of faith into music to finding her footing as an independent artist and standing by her mother through cancer treatment, she shares how life's unexpected turns opened doors she never imagined. Through heartfelt stories and music, Shreya explores a powerful idea - what if the moments that seem to pull us off course are the very ones leading us towards possibilities we never knew existed? Shreya Karmakar is a prominent Indian independent singer, songwriter, and vocal coach based in Mumbai. She gained massive digital stardom through her viral Bollywood acoustic covers, with her version of "Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai" amassing over 29 million views on YouTube.Beyond covers, she writes and composes her own music, releasing hit indie singles like "Apsara" and "Sajnaa". Today, she commands over 720,000 subscribers
title: What If Struggle Is Just A Possibility in Disguise? | Shreya Karmakar | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description: Sipika Nigam is a venture capital investor with over 14 years of experience across investments, private equity and the startup ecosystem and an alumna of SDA Bocconi Asia Center. In this talk, Sipika draws on 15 years and over 4,000 conversations, from renting real estate in Bombay to fundraising through the Andhra microfinance crisis to sitting across 3,000 farmers to unpack why information alone rarely gets you to a breakthrough. She lays out a simple model - context, trust, sparring, breakthrough, showing how the same apartments, the same pitch decks and the same rejections look entirely different once you stop collecting facts about someone and start getting curious about where they're actually coming from. "Sipika Nigam is a venture capital investor with over 14 years of experience across investments, private equity, and the startup ecosystem. As an alumna of SDA Bocconi Asia Center, she has worked closely with founders and early-stage startups, helping them scale through strateg
title: Information Isn't Understanding | Sipika Nigam | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Vibhuti Sharma is a singer, songwriter and composer signed to Warner Music India. In her talk and performance, she shares how music has been her lens for processing emotion, taking feelings like constancy, longing and unspoken love and translating them into melody. She weaves together personal moments, from a quiet realization under the night sky to an overheard confession of restraint, showing how everyday experiences shape the songs she writes and the perspective she brings to the stage. "Vibhuti Sharma is a singer, songwriter, and live performer known for her versatility across Bollywood, Sufi, and independent music. She has performed extensively across India and collaborated with renowned artists while continuing to create original music.
Through music, she connects with audiences in ways that words often cannot. Her journey and artistic expression would offer a refreshing perspective on emotion, creativity, and the different ways people experience the world." This talk was given
title: The Emotional Blueprint of a Song | Vibhuti Sharma | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Divya Unny is an award-winning filmmaker, writer  and actor. In this talk, Divya traces the decade she spent between newsrooms and film sets marked by her mother's sudden death, a magazine shutting down the night before her first shoot and years of auditions met with silence instead of answers. Instead of a success story, she offers a harder question - what if it doesn't work out the way you dreamed and can you still love who you see the next morning? "Divya Unny is an award-winning filmmaker, writer, and actor whose work spans independent films, branded storytelling, and advertising. Her films have been recognised at international festivals for their emotionally rich and visually compelling narratives.
Her stories often uncover the extraordinary in everyday moments, encouraging audiences to look beyond the obvious. Her approach to storytelling would bring a creative and deeply human perspective to the stage." This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but ind
title: What If It Doesn't Work Out? | Divya Unny | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description: Abhijeet Anand, Founder and CEO of abcoffee. In his talk, Abhijeet explores five questions that have shaped some of the defining choices in his life. Are we setting our own standards, or simply accepting the ones around us? What assumptions are limiting what we believe is possible? And when an opportunity appears in an unexpected form, are we prepared to recognise it? Drawing from turning points across his journey from engineering and industry to entrepreneurship and social impact, he examines how questioning what we take for granted can change the way we approach ambition, opportunity and excellence. Rather than offering ready-made answers, Abhijeet leaves us with a more enduring idea - the questions we choose to ask can shape the choices we make and ultimately, the person we become. "Abhijeet Anand is the Co-founder and CEO of AbCoffee, one of India's fastest-growing specialty coffee brands. Before launching the venture, he built his career in consulting and finance, bringing togeth
title: Five Questions That Change What You See and Who You Become  | Abhijeet Anand | TEDxBocconiUMumbai

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Durante años, cada vez que iba a la feria de Tristán Narvaja, en Montevideo, cruzaba de vereda para evitar mirar un puesto donde vendían animales en condiciones deplorables. Hasta que un día dejé de hacerlo. Lo que empezó como una historia de Instagram terminó en una petición con miles de firmas, reuniones con autoridades y una colaboración con Interpol en una investigación sobre tráfico internacional de animales.
Pero la consecuencia más importante no fue el cierre del puesto: fue descubrir una vocación que ni siquiera sabía que tenía.
¿Por qué esperamos sentirnos preparados antes de hacer algo? ¿Cuántas veces creemos que necesitamos más conocimientos, experiencia o seguridad para dar el primer paso?
A través de una historia personal, esta charla explora cómo la espera puede convertirse en una forma de proteger la persona que imaginamos ser, mientras postergamos la oportunidad de descubrir quiénes podemos llegar a ser.
Porque capaz no necesitamos convertirnos primero en la persona ca
title: La vereda de enfrente. | Sofía Tardáguila | TEDxColonia Del Sacramento
